_comment: Parameters for system-managed backend behavior and automatically injected components.

session._comment: Server-side working-model store (backend is the source of truth; the frontend fetches pages/windows on demand). Tunables for temporal-chart windowing.

load_shedding._comment: Per-bus load-shedding (VOLL) generators, added only when enableLoadShedding=true. The marginal_cost here is the backend default; the running app can override it from frontend Settings in the user-selected currency.
